sources.title: GiveDirectly: Send money to people living in poverty
sources.useful_content: GiveDirectly presents direct cash as a way to help people transform their lives and choose for themselves how best to improve them.

sources.title: About GiveDirectly
sources.useful_content: The about page states that GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1 billion in cash to more than 2 million people living in poverty since 2009.

sources.title: GiveDirectly jobs | GiveDirectly openings
sources.useful_content: The requested impact route rendered GiveDirectly's official jobs and openings content and was normalized as careers evidence.

sources.title: Financials | GiveDirectly
sources.useful_content: The financials page explains what happens to donations and states an aim to make nonprofit finances transparent and straightforward.

sources.title: Give Now | GiveDirectly
sources.useful_content: The donation page provides a direct fundraising entry point and recipient examples describing uses of cash transfers.

sources.title: Contact Us | GiveDirectly
sources.useful_content: The contact page provides an official stakeholder entry point and explains that people cannot apply directly for program funds.

mission_signals: People in poverty deserve the dignity to choose for themselves how best to improve their lives — cash enables that choice.
Since 2009, GiveDirectly says it has delivered cash directly to more than 2 million people living in poverty.
program_signals: GiveDirectly describes cash transfers as a well-studied aid intervention.
Its programs are funded by individual donors, foundations, businesses, and institutions.
impact_signals: GiveDirectly says research has shown impacts from cash transfers even five or more years after a transfer.
The site links to research on cash transfers.
fundraising_signals: The site describes funding from individual donors, foundations, businesses, and institutions.
A Give Now page provides the primary donation entry point.
